system: P00947 tKSI, author numbering explicitly checked

hypotheses.claim: Binding-contact residues and catalytic residues overlap but have distinct roles
hypotheses.method: WT 8CHO vs D38N 1QJG EQU contacts, cutoff 4.5 A; report mutations; no p-value from atoms

hypotheses.claim: pH changes local protonation/field; temperature and salt modify the electrostatic response
hypotheses.design: pH5/7/9 x T288.15/298.15/310.15K x ionic strength0/.15/.30M; APBS65; shared structure; empirical pKa fixed with T
hypotheses.reject_approximation_if: grid 65/97/129 changes probe field norm >10%; report rather than hide discrepancy

hypotheses.claim: Catalytic-site RMSF differs from remaining protein; site residues show coupled fluctuations
hypotheses.unit: independent seeded trajectory, not frames or atoms
hypotheses.design: 3 independent trajectories at nominal pH7 T298.15K from prepared WT biological dimer, burn-in and sampling explicitly recorded
hypotheses.test: two-sided exact paired sign-flip on replicate RMSF difference; BH correction across tested role groups; n=3 has minimum p=.25

hypotheses.claim: Coupled side-chain torsions have nonadditive frozen-environment potential energy
hypotheses.method: OpenMM conditional torsion scan and double-difference energy; no claim of equilibrium free energy

hypotheses.claim: Stepwise proton abstraction and reprotonation require ES -> TS1 -> EI -> TS2 -> EP
hypotheses.method: literature evidence and explicit state graph; projected electronic PES optional; full TS requires 3N stationary point/index1 and path connectivity
hypotheses.status_rule: No inferred kcat without validated activation free energies; missing TS remains unresolved

uncertainty_policy: No inferential p-values from a deterministic factorial scan; sparse trajectories yield exploratory inference only
